title: Introduction to Programming
author: John Zelle
summary: This book introduces fundamental programming concepts using Python. It focuses on problem-solving, logic building, and understanding how programs work. Topics such as variables, loops, conditionals, and functions are explained with simple examples. It is designed for complete beginners and helps readers develop confidence in writing basic programs.

title: Python Crash Course

It emphasizes learning by doing, making it ideal for beginners who want hands-on experience.
